title: I-028 attachment ingest, analysis artifacts, and evidence projection
clauseOfficialized: Over-limit text is refused and is not silently truncated (page/byte locators are kept on in-limit bodies). Observations and inferences stay separate and remain page or PTS traceable; an inference without supports is refused. Hash plus extractor/model parameters cache deduplicates, and a new question misses. Missing uploadSubset consent does not upload (networkRequestCount stays 0); a license warning cannot exempt it. A tight projection budget is partial with omitted ids and cannot be marked complete. Unsupported formats and unconfigured visual analysis fail explicitly (FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED / MODEL_UNAVAILABLE).
whyNotAlreadyOfficial: I-028 was planned with no studio_context package.
